criteria.text: Reserving stock reduces available quantity but not on-hand quantity.
A reservation larger than available stock is rejected with InsufficientStock and reserves nothing.
Reservations not confirmed within 48 hours are released automatically.
When available stock falls below the reorder point one purchase suggestion is created, and no duplicate while one is open.
Transfers between locations keep the total on-hand quantity unchanged.
A transfer from a location with insufficient stock fails and changes neither location.
Cycle count differences are booked as an adjustment move with reason "count".
A move that would make on-hand negative raises NegativeStock and leaves on-hand unchanged.
Reservations are released when their order is cancelled.

T01.name: test_reserve_reduces_available
T01.code:
def test_reserve_reduces_available(ledger, book):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)

    book.reserve(BOLTS, 4, order_id="SO-1001", now=NOW)

    assert book.available(BOLTS) == 6
    assert ledger.on_hand(BOLTS) == 10

T02.name: test_issue_reduces_on_hand
T02.code:
def test_issue_reduces_on_hand(ledger):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 40)

    move = ledger.issue(BOLTS, SHELF_A, 15, ref="SO-1001")

    assert ledger.on_hand_at(BOLTS, SHELF_A) == 25
    assert move.kind == "issue"
    assert move.qty == -15

    ledger.issue(BOLTS, SHELF_A, 25, ref="SO-1002")

    assert ledger.on_hand_at(BOLTS, SHELF_A) == 0

T06.name: test_confirmed_reservation_is_kept
T06.code:
def test_confirmed_reservation_is_kept(ledger, book):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    res = book.reserve(BOLTS, 4, order_id="SO-2002", now=NOW)
    book.confirm(res.id)

    released = book.release_expired(hours_later(200))

    assert released == []
    assert book.reserved(BOLTS) == 4

    status = book.status(BOLTS)

    assert (status.on_hand, status.reserved, status.available) == (10, 4, 6)

T08.name: test_only_old_reservations_released
T08.code:
def test_only_old_reservations_released(ledger, book):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    stock(ledger, NUTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    old = book.reserve(BOLTS, 4, order_id="SO-2003", now=NOW)
    fresh = book.reserve(NUTS, 3, order_id="SO-2004", now=hours_later(40))

    released = book.release_expired(hours_later(50))

    assert released == [old]
    assert fresh.released is False

def test_suggestion_created_below_point(ledger, book, reorder):

T12.name: test_on_hand_total_across_locations
T12.code:
def test_on_hand_total_across_locations(ledger):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 40)
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_B, 25)
    stock(ledger, NUTS, SHELF_A, 100)

    assert ledger.on_hand(BOLTS) == 65
    assert ledger.on_hand(NUTS) == 100
    assert ledger.by_location(BOLTS) == {SHELF_A: 40, SHELF_B: 25}

    ledger.issue(BOLTS, SHELF_B, 5)

    assert ledger.on_hand(BOLTS) == 60
    assert ledger.skus() == [BOLTS, NUTS]

T13.name: test_transfer_keeps_reference

def test_transfer_keeps_reference(ledger):

T17.name: test_count_without_difference_posts_nothing
T17.code:
def test_count_without_difference_posts_nothing(ledger, counts):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 20)
    moves_before = len(ledger.moves)

    result = counts.record(BOLTS, SHELF_A, counted=20, counted_by="mia", now=NOW)

    assert result.variance == 0
    assert len(ledger.moves) == moves_before

T18.name: test_adjustment_can_go_either_way
T18.code:
def test_adjustment_can_go_either_way(ledger):
    stock(ledger, NUTS, SHELF_B, 80)

    up = ledger.adjust(NUTS, SHELF_B, 4, reason="found in returns bin")
    down = ledger.adjust(NUTS, SHELF_B, -6, reason="label mix-up")

    assert (up.qty, down.qty) == (4, -6)
    assert up.kind == down.kind == "adjustment"
    assert ledger.on_hand_at(NUTS, SHELF_B) == 78

T19.name: test_moves_recorded_in_order
T19.code:
def test_moves_recorded_in_order(ledger):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 50)
    ledger.issue(BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    ledger.scrap(BOLTS, SHELF_A, 2, reason="rusted")
    ledger.adjust(BOLTS, SHELF_A, 1, reason="found behind shelf")

    kinds = [m.kind for m in ledger.moves]

    assert kinds == [
        "receipt",
        "issue",
        "scrap",
        "adjustment",
    ]
    assert ledger.on_hand_at(BOLTS, SHELF_A) == 39

T23.name: test_cancelled_order_cannot_ship
T23.code:
def test_cancelled_order_cannot_ship(ledger, orders):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    stock(ledger, NUTS, SHELF_A, 50)
    order = _order("SO-4006")
    orders.place(order, NOW)
    orders.cancel(order)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        orders.ship(order, SHELF_A)

    assert ledger.on_hand(BOLTS) == 10
    assert order.status == "cancelled"

T24.name: test_shipped_order_cannot_be_cancelled
T24.code:
def test_shipped_order_cannot_be_cancelled(ledger, orders):
    stock(ledger, BOLTS, SHELF_A, 10)
    stock(ledger, NUTS, SHELF_A, 50)
    order = _order("SO-4005", paid=12900)
    orders.place(order, NOW)
    orders.ship(order, SHELF_A)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        orders.cancel(order)

    assert order.status == "shipped"
    assert order.refunded == 0
